prompt:
This is a simulation; do not call tools or write files. The user invokes nb-ultra: "Turn the meeting notes into a one-page decision memo and a separate action checklist for the operations team. Save both documents in the supplied working folder."
Exact inspected state: a writable task working folder contains notes.md and the team's brief style-guide.md. It is not a Git repository, has no source code, build/test system, README, wiki, remote service, native goal tool or running workers. File operations and content readback are available. Complete notes: the team approved starting a two-week internal help-desk pilot on Monday 14 September 2026; pilot owner is the Operations Lead; support hours are 09:00-17:00 Europe/Warsaw; requests go to the existing internal portal; success means at least 90 percent of pilot requests are acknowledged within one business day; the owner prepares the intake form before launch and reviews results Friday 25 September. Style guide: plain English, decision first, use role names, no invented benefits or numbers. Audience and acceptance are complete; no publication or messages to people are authorized.
Give the next execution steps, output file names and actual-layer verification. Stay below 150 words.
required: Executes conceptually using the provided folder and source notes without needing a repository, branch, commit or test runner.
Keeps one concise checklist and chooses artifact/content comparison and file readback as verification.
Preserves the exact dates, timezone, hours, roles and 90-percent/one-business-day criterion.
Does not create goal infrastructure, a wiki, scaffold or send/publish the memo.
fail_if: Blocks on missing Git/native-goal tooling or requires git init/git diff before drafting.
Invents unsupported benefits, assigns private identities or sends the documents externally.
